description: Search active Brazilian fixed-income bonds and rank them. Every bond comes with net_annualized_return (after IR, to maturity) and real_annualized_return (above IPCA), both decimals. 'rate' depends on 'index': cdi* 1.05 = 105% of CDI, cdi+ 0.02 = CDI + 2% a.a., ipca+ 0.06 = IPCA + 6% a.a., pre 0.13 = 13% a.a. fixed. Without an API key the result is a short preview.

bank.description: Issuer/broker codes, as listed by list_issuers (e.g. 341 Itaú, 77 Inter, 208 BTG).

fgc.description: true: only bonds covered by the FGC guarantee (up to R$ 250,000 per CPF per institution).

index.description: Indexers: cdi* (% of CDI), cdi+ (CDI + spread), ipca*, ipca+ (IPCA + spread), selic*, selic+, pre (fixed rate).

max_min_investment.description: Only bonds whose minimum investment is at most this amount in BRL.

max_years.description: Only bonds maturing within this many years from today.

product.description: Product types: cdb, lci, lca, cri, cra, deb (debênture), tpf/td (Tesouro Direto), lf (letra financeira), misc.

sort_by.description: net_return / real_return: highest first. maturity: soonest first. min_investment: lowest first.

tax_free.description: true: only IR-exempt bonds (LCI, LCA, CRI, CRA, incentivized debêntures). false: only taxed ones.

name: search_bonds
title: Buscar títulos de renda fixa
